```
        BackendAgent? backendAgent,
        SdkSessionMcpToolSelection.Selection mcpSelection,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        bool includeBuiltIns = registeredAgent?.Options.IncludeBuiltInContributions != false;
        var sources = includeBuiltIns ? this.toolsProvider.Sources.Items : [];
        // Continuation tools remain available even when an agent opts out of built-in contributions.
        var inventory = sources.Concat(this.composedToolSources.Items.OfType<LegacyTranscriptToolSource>())
            .SelectMany(source => source.Tools.Items.Select(tool => new ContributionInSource(tool, source.Kind)))
            .ToList();
        if (includeBuiltIns)
        {
            var requirements = SdkSessionMcpHostFactory.ResolveRequirements(
                backendAgent, this.mcpHost.Tools.Items, this.markdownToolPolicy);
            var tools = await this.mcpHost.GetAvailableToolsAsync(
                mcpSelection.WithRequirements(requirements), cancellationToken);
            inventory.AddRange(this.mcpToolsProvider.GetContributions(tools)
                .Select(tool => new ContributionInSource(tool, BackendToolSourceKind.McpServer)));
        }

        return inventory;
    }

    private async Task<RequestToolSelection> SelectRequestToolsAsync(
            RegisteredSdkAgent? registeredAgent,
            BackendAgent? backendAgent,
            IList<GitHub.Copilot.CustomAgentConfig>? configurations,
            IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> agentTools,
            SdkSessionMcpToolSelection.Selection mcpSelection,
            CopilotModelRequest? modelRequest,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        List<ContributionInSource> inventory = await this.SnapshotRequestInventoryAsync(
            registeredAgent, backendAgent, mcpSelection, cancellationToken);
        SdkAskToolSelection? askSelection = ReferenceEquals(registeredAgent, AskAgent)
            ? SdkAskToolPolicy.CreateToolSelection(inventory, this.toolPolicy.Current, this.toolPolicy.DisabledToolNames)
            : null;
        var reviewedTools = new List<VsToolContribution>();
        if (askSelection is null && agentTools.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (var tool in this.toolsProvider.Sources.Items
                .SelectMany(source => source.Tools.Items)
                .OfType<VsToolContribution>()
                .Where(tool => tool.IsAllowedInAsk))
            {
                reviewedTools.AddRange((await tool.ResolveVirtualFunctionsAsync(modelRequest, cancellationToken)).OfType<VsToolContribution>());
            }
        }

        (List<IBackendToolContribution> tools, HashSet<string> defaultNames) = askSelection is not null
            ? (askSelection.HostTools.ToList(), new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            : this.SelectedHostContributions(inventory, this.markdownToolPolicy.CreatePreferences(
                SdkMarkdownAgentToolPolicy.GetRequirements(backendAgent), inventory, this.toolPolicy.Current), agentTools, reviewedTools);
        if (ReferenceEquals(registeredAgent, AskAgent))
        {
            defaultNames.UnionWith(tools.Select(tool => tool.Name.Value));
        }

        var pickerNames = tools.Select(tool => tool.Name.Value).ToImmutableHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var rootTools = tools.Where(tool => defaultNames.Contains(tool.Name.Value)).ToArray();
        var markdownAgents = new Dictionary<string, MarkdownAgentToolSelection>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (configurations is VsCustomAgentConfigurations registeredConfigurations)
        {
            var names = tools.Select(tool => tool.Name.Value).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var config in configurations)
            {
                if (registeredConfigurations.ResolveRegistration(config.Name)
                    is not RegisteredMarkdownSdkAgent { Requirements.Tools.Count: > 0 } markdownAgent)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                bool isSelected = ReferenceEquals(markdownAgent, registeredAgent);
                List<ContributionInSource> agentInventory = isSelected
                    ? inventory
                    : await this.SnapshotRequestInventoryAsync(
                        markdownAgent, markdownAgent.ToBackendAgent(), mcpSelection, cancellationToken);
                IReadOnlyList<IBackendToolContribution> selectedTools = isSelected
                    ? rootTools
                    : this.SelectedHostContributions(agentInventory, this.markdownToolPolicy.CreatePreferences(
                        markdownAgent.Requirements, agentInventory, this.toolPolicy.Current), []).selectedContributions;
                markdownAgents.Add(config.Name, new(agentInventory, selectedTools));
                foreach (IBackendToolContribution tool in selectedTools)
                {
                    if (names.Add(tool.Name.Value))
                    {
                        tools.Add(tool);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return new(tools, defaultNames.ToImmutableHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase), pickerNames, askSelection?.AvailableTools, markdownAgents);
    }

    private sealed record RequestToolSelection(
        IReadOnlyList<IBackendToolContribution> Tools,
        ImmutableHashSet<string> DefaultAgentToolNames,
        ImmutableHashSet<string> PickerToolNames,
        GitHub.Copilot.ToolSet? AvailableTools,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, MarkdownAgentToolSelection> MarkdownAgents);

    private readonly record struct MarkdownAgentToolSelection(
        IReadOnlyList<ContributionInSource> Inventory,
        IReadOnlyList<IBackendToolContribution> Tools);
```

```
    /// <summary>
    /// Central shared state for tracking first-party tool activations.
    /// Shared across all <see cref="FirstPartyToolsProvider"/> instances to avoid
    /// redundant UIContext subscriptions and service queries.
    /// </summary>
    [Export]
    public class ToolsState : IDisposable
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Window used to coalesce bursts of upstream provider notifications. Long enough to
        /// collapse a startup flurry of <c>OnNext</c> emissions (the initial descriptor list
        /// from each provider, plus any rapid follow-on updates and reconnect-driven replays
        /// triggered by <see cref="IServiceBroker.AvailabilityChanged"/>) into a single
        /// re-evaluation, short enough that users do not perceive a delay before tools appear.
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly TimeSpan ProviderChangeThrottleWindow = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50);

        private readonly JoinableTaskFactory jtf;
        private readonly AsyncLazyInitializer toolsInitializer;
        private readonly TraceSource traceSource;
        private readonly HostApp currentHost;
        private readonly HashSet<Guid> activeContexts = new();
        private readonly ReentrantSemaphore semaphore;
        private readonly List<UIContext> subscribedUiContexts = new();
        private readonly FirstPartyToolSubscriptions subscriptions;
        private readonly FirstPartyToolEvaluator evaluator;
        private readonly IDisposable providerChangeSubscription;

        private ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> activeTools = ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>>.Empty;
        private ImmutableList<IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>>> observers = ImmutableList<IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>>>.Empty;

        [ImportingConstructor]
        public ToolsState(
            [Import(typeof(SVsFullAccessServiceBroker))] IServiceBroker serviceBroker,
            ConversationsTraceSource conversationsTraceSource,
            [ConversationsJoinableTaskFactory] JoinableTaskFactory joinableTaskFactory,
            [Import(AllowDefault = true)] ICopilotHostEnvironment? hostEnvironment = null)
        {
            this.jtf = joinableTaskFactory;
            this.traceSource = conversationsTraceSource.TraceSource;
            this.currentHost = hostEnvironment?.Service.HostApp ?? HostApp.VisualStudio;
            this.semaphore = ReentrantSemaphore.Create(joinableTaskContext: joinableTaskFactory.Context);
            this.toolsInitializer = new AsyncLazyInitializer(this.InitializeToolsAsync, joinableTaskFactory);
            this.subscriptions = new FirstPartyToolSubscriptions(serviceBroker);
            this.evaluator = new FirstPartyToolEvaluator(FirstPartyTools, this.currentHost, this.subscriptions);

            // Coalesce upstream provider updates with Throttle so a burst of OnNext callbacks
            // (initial descriptor lists, rapid follow-on updates, and replays that fire when
            // GetSafeObservable reconnects after AvailabilityChanged) collapses into a single
            // re-evaluation. The throttle scheduler also defers emission off the calling stack,
            // which prevents reentry into ReevaluateToolsAsync from within the
            // EnsureSubscribedAsync call below.
            this.providerChangeSubscription = this.subscriptions.FunctionsChanged
                .Throttle(ProviderChangeThrottleWindow)
                .SubscribeWithoutRx(_ => this.OnProviderFunctionsChanged());
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            foreach (var context in this.subscribedUiContexts)
            {
                context.UIContextChanged -= this.OnUIContextChanged;
            }

            this.subscribedUiContexts.Clear();

            this.providerChangeSubscription.Dispose();
            this.subscriptions.Dispose();
        }

        public Task EnsureInitializedAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            => this.toolsInitializer.InitializeAsync(cancellationToken);

        public IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> GetActiveTools()
            => FilterTools(this.activeTools);

        public IDisposable Subscribe(IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> observer)
        {
            ImmutableInterlocked.Update(ref this.observers, observers => observers.Add(observer));
            observer.OnNext(this.GetActiveTools());

            return new DisposeAction(() =>
            {
                ImmutableInterlocked.Update(ref this.observers, observers => observers.Remove(observer));
            });
        }

        private async Task InitializeToolsAsync()
        {
            await this.jtf.SwitchToMainThreadAsync();

            foreach (var uiContextGuid in FirstPartyTools
                .Where(tool => tool.AppliesTo(this.currentHost))
                .Select(tool => tool.UIContext)
                .Distinct())
            {
                var uiContextImpl = UIContext.FromUIContextGuid(uiContextGuid);

                if (uiContextImpl is not null)
                {
                    if (uiContextImpl.IsActive)
                    {
                        // Safe to mutate outside the semaphore: this runs on the UI thread before the
                        // UIContextChanged handler is attached, so no other path can read activeContexts yet.
                        this.activeContexts.Add(uiContextGuid);
                    }

                    uiContextImpl.UIContextChanged += this.OnUIContextChanged;
                    this.subscribedUiContexts.Add(uiContextImpl);
                }
            }

            this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid.Empty, VsShellUtilities.ShutdownToken).FileAndForgetIgnoringCancellation(nameof(FirstPartyToolsProvider));
        }

        private void OnUIContextChanged(object sender, UIContextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            var uiContext = (UIContext)sender;
            this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(uiContext.Guid, e.Activated, VsShellUtilities.ShutdownToken).FileAndForgetIgnoringCancellation(nameof(FirstPartyToolsProvider));
        }

        private Task ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid uiContext, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            => this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(uiContext, activated: null, cancellationToken);

        private async Task ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid uiContext, bool? activated, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await this.semaphore.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
            {
                // Apply UIContext activation changes inside the semaphore so reads of activeContexts
                // during evaluation cannot race with mutations from UIContext callbacks.
                if (activated == true)
                {
                    this.activeContexts.Add(uiContext);
                }
                else if (activated == false)
                {
                    this.activeContexts.Remove(uiContext);
                }

                // Make sure we are subscribed to every upstream provider whose descriptors we may
                // need this pass. Subscriptions are idempotent and persist for the lifetime of
                // ToolsState; this loop only does real work on first call.
                foreach (var moniker in this.evaluator.GetMonikersRequiringSubscription())
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await this.subscriptions.EnsureSubscribedAsync(moniker, cancellationToken);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        this.traceSource.Error($"Failed to subscribe to {moniker} when initializing first party tools. {ex}.");
                    }
                }

                var previousTools = this.activeTools;
                var currentTools = this.evaluator.Evaluate(previousTools, this.activeContexts.Contains, uiContext);

                this.activeTools = currentTools;
                if (previousTools != currentTools)
                {
                    this.NotifyObservers(currentTools);
                }
            }, cancellationToken);
        }

        private void NotifyObservers(ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> tools)
        {
            var toolList = FilterTools(tools);
            foreach (var observer in this.observers)
            {
                try
                {
                    observer.OnNext(toolList);
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Observer faults must not break the provider; this matches the existing IObservable contract.
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Tools superseded by the handoff tool. When the handoff tool is enabled these are dropped,
        /// because the same agents are reachable through it.
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly ImmutableHashSet<string> HandoffReplacedToolNames = ImmutableHashSet.Create(
            CreateUpgradeThread.Name,
            "profiler_agent");

        private static IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> FilterTools(ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> tools)
        {
            var flattened = tools.Values.SelectMany(d => d);

            if (ConversationsOptions.Instance.EnableHandoffTool)
            {
                flattened = flattened.Where(tool => !HandoffReplacedToolNames.Contains(tool.Name));
            }

            return flattened.ToList();
        }

        private void OnProviderFunctionsChanged()
        {
            this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid.Empty, VsShellUtilities.ShutdownToken).FileAndForgetIgnoringCancellation(nameof(FirstPartyToolsProvider));
        }
    }
```

```
// Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

#nullable enable

using System.Collections.Immutable;
using Microsoft.ServiceHub.Framework;
using Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.Core.HostEnvironment;

using FirstPartyTool = Microsoft.VisualStudio.Conversations.Functions.FirstPartyToolsProvider.FirstPartyTool;
using NamedTool = Microsoft.VisualStudio.Conversations.Functions.FirstPartyToolsProvider.NamedTool;

namespace Microsoft.VisualStudio.Conversations.Functions;

/// <summary>
/// Computes the active first-party tool descriptor map for a re-evaluation pass. Pure with
/// respect to its inputs: given the same <see cref="IFirstPartyToolSubscriptions"/> cache state
/// and the same UIContext set, two calls produce the same output. All side effects
/// (subscribing to providers, mutating the active map, notifying observers) live in the caller.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class FirstPartyToolEvaluator
{
    private readonly IReadOnlyList<FirstPartyTool> tools;
    private readonly HostApp currentHost;
    private readonly IFirstPartyToolSubscriptions subscriptions;

    public FirstPartyToolEvaluator(
        IReadOnlyList<FirstPartyTool> tools,
        HostApp currentHost,
        IFirstPartyToolSubscriptions subscriptions)
    {
        this.tools = tools;
        this.currentHost = currentHost;
        this.subscriptions = subscriptions;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the updated tool-to-descriptors map for this re-evaluation pass.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="previous">The current active map; used as the base for the new map.</param>
    /// <param name="isContextActive">Predicate returning <see langword="true"/> when the given UIContext is currently active.</param>
    /// <param name="changedUIContext">
    /// The UIContext that triggered this pass, or <see cref="Guid.Empty"/> to evaluate every tool
    /// (initial load or upstream-provider-driven update).
    /// </param>
    public ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> Evaluate(
        ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> previous,
        Func<Guid, bool> isContextActive,
        Guid changedUIContext)
    {
        var current = previous;

        foreach (var tool in this.tools)
        {
            if (!this.ShouldEvaluate(tool, changedUIContext))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var descriptors = this.GetActiveDescriptorsFor(tool, isContextActive);
            if (descriptors.IsDefault)
            {
                current = current.Remove(tool);
            }
            else if (!current.TryGetValue(tool, out var existing) || !existing.SequenceEqual(descriptors))
            {
                current = current.SetItem(tool, descriptors);
            }
        }

        return current;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the service monikers this evaluator will read function lists for. The caller is
    /// expected to call <see cref="IFirstPartyToolSubscriptions.EnsureSubscribedAsync"/> for each
    /// of these before calling <see cref="Evaluate"/>, so the cache is populated when evaluation
    /// runs.
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<ServiceMoniker> GetMonikersRequiringSubscription()
    {
        foreach (var tool in this.tools)
        {
            if (!tool.AppliesTo(this.currentHost))
            {
                continue;
            }

            // Prebuilt named tools carry their own descriptor and don't need a provider subscription.
            if (tool is NamedTool { Descriptor: not null })
            {
                continue;
            }

            yield return tool.Moniker;
        }
    }

    private bool ShouldEvaluate(FirstPartyTool tool, Guid changedUIContext)
    {
        if (!tool.AppliesTo(this.currentHost))
        {
            return false;
        }

        // Guid.Empty means "evaluate all tools" (e.g. initial load or provider-driven update).
        return changedUIContext == Guid.Empty || changedUIContext == tool.UIContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the descriptors that should be active for <paramref name="tool"/> right now.
    /// <see cref="ImmutableArray{T}.IsDefault"/> = <see langword="true"/> means "not active",
    /// signalling the caller to remove this tool from the active map.
    /// </summary>
    private ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> GetActiveDescriptorsFor(FirstPartyTool tool, Func<Guid, bool> isContextActive)
    {
        if (!isContextActive(tool.UIContext))
        {
            return default;
        }

        if (tool is NamedTool { Descriptor: { } prebuilt })
        {
            return [prebuilt];
        }

        var cached = this.subscriptions.GetCachedFunctions(tool.Moniker);
        var matched = tool.MatchFunctions(cached);
        return matched.IsDefaultOrEmpty ? default : matched;
    }
```
```
}

    /// <summary>
    /// Represents a first-party tool (or set of tools) registration. The base record is abstract —
    /// concrete entries pick one of <see cref="NamedTool"/>, <see cref="McpServerTool"/>, or
    /// <see cref="AllFromProviderTool"/> to declare how the entry matches descriptors returned by
    /// its function provider. Host gating is independent of the match mode and is controlled by
    /// <see cref="ApplicableHost"/>; entries are filtered out before any UIContext or service work
    /// runs in non-applicable shells.
    /// </summary>
    public abstract record FirstPartyTool
    {
        /// <summary>Service moniker for the function provider that owns the tool(s).</summary>
        public ServiceMoniker Moniker { get; }

        /// <summary>UIContext when the tool(s) should be added to the agent mode tool picker.</summary>
        public Guid UIContext { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Host this tool entry applies to. Every entry must specify this explicitly so that adding
        /// a new tool requires the author to think about which shell(s) should see it.
        /// </summary>
        public FirstPartyToolHost ApplicableHost { get; init; } = FirstPartyToolHost.VisualStudio;

        /// <summary>Human-readable description of what this entry matches, for trace messages.</summary>
        internal abstract string MatchDescription { get; }

        /// <summary>Filters the descriptors returned by the function provider down to the ones this entry owns.</summary>
        internal abstract ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> MatchFunctions(IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> functions);

        /// <summary>True when this entry should be considered in the given <paramref name="host"/>.</summary>
        internal bool AppliesTo(HostApp host) => this.ApplicableHost switch
        {
            FirstPartyToolHost.All => true,
            FirstPartyToolHost.VisualStudio => host == HostApp.VisualStudio,
            FirstPartyToolHost.SqlServerManagementStudio => host == HostApp.SQLServerManagementStudio,
            _ => false,
        };

        protected FirstPartyTool(ServiceMoniker moniker, Guid uiContext)
        {
            this.Moniker = moniker;
            this.UIContext = uiContext;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers a single first-party tool by exact name. Optionally accepts a pre-built
    /// <see cref="Descriptor"/>, in which case the function provider is not queried at all.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed record NamedTool : FirstPartyTool
    {
        /// <summary>Exact tool name to match against the provider's returned descriptors.</summary>
        public string Name { get; }

        /// <summary>Optional pre-built descriptor; when supplied the provider is not queried.</summary>
        public CopilotFunctionDescriptor? Descriptor { get; }

        public NamedTool(ServiceMoniker moniker, string name, Guid uiContext, CopilotFunctionDescriptor? descriptor = null)
            : base(moniker, uiContext)
        {
            this.Name = name;
            this.Descriptor = descriptor;
        }

        internal override string MatchDescription => this.Name;

        internal override ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> MatchFunctions(IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> functions)
        {
            var descriptor = functions.FirstOrDefault(f => f.Name == this.Name);
            return descriptor is null ? ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>.Empty : ImmutableArray.Create(descriptor);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers every tool exposed by the named first-party MCP server. The MCP aggregator returns
    /// functions from all configured MCP servers; this entry filters down to ones whose owning
    /// server name equals <see cref="McpServerName"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed record McpServerTool : FirstPartyTool
    {
        /// <summary>Name of the MCP server whose tools should be enabled.</summary>
        public string McpServerName { get; }

        public McpServerTool(string mcpServerName, Guid uiContext)
            : base(new(CopilotDescriptorConstants.McpToolServiceName, new(CopilotDescriptors.CurrentResponderVersion)), uiContext)
        {
            this.McpServerName = mcpServerName;
        }

        internal override string MatchDescription => $"MCP server '{this.McpServerName}'";

        internal override ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> MatchFunctions(IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> functions)
            => functions
                .OfType<CopilotMcpFunctionDescriptor>()
                .Where(f => string.Equals(f.Group, this.McpServerName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                .Cast<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>()
                .ToImmutableArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers every tool returned by the named function provider. Use only with providers that
    /// exclusively own their own (first-party) tools.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed record AllFromProviderTool : FirstPartyTool
    {
        public AllFromProviderTool(ServiceMoniker moniker, Guid uiContext)
            : base(moniker, uiContext)
        {
        }

        internal override string MatchDescription => "all tools from provider";

        internal override ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> MatchFunctions(IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> functions)
            => functions.ToImmutableArray();
    }
```

```
// Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

#nullable enable

using Microsoft.ServiceHub.Framework;
using Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.Core.GenericUtilities;

namespace Microsoft.VisualStudio.Conversations.Functions;

/// <summary>
/// Caches live subscriptions to upstream <see cref="ICopilotFunctionProvider"/> services and
/// exposes their most recently published function lists. Replaces snapshot
/// <c>GetFunctionsAsync</c> calls so that late-arriving descriptors (for example MCP servers
/// that have not yet completed <c>tools/list</c>) are picked up automatically.
/// </summary>
internal interface IFirstPartyToolSubscriptions : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Pulses whenever any provider publishes a new function list. Multiple providers fan in
    /// to a single stream so consumers can subscribe once and apply rate-limiting operators
    /// (for example <c>Throttle</c>) at the boundary instead of per-provider.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Emissions occur on whatever thread the upstream provider chose to publish on. Consumers
    /// that need to coalesce bursts or hop off the calling stack should compose with
    /// <c>Throttle</c> or a similar operator before subscribing.
    /// </remarks>
    IObservable<Unit> FunctionsChanged { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ensures a subscription exists for <paramref name="moniker"/>. Idempotent: subsequent calls
    /// are no-ops once the subscription is established.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Returns as soon as the per-moniker subscription has been registered; the underlying
    /// <see cref="IServiceBroker.GetProxyAsync"/> and <see cref="ICopilotFunctionProvider.SubscribeForFunctionsAsync"/>
    /// run asynchronously, so <see cref="GetCachedFunctions"/> returns an empty list until the
    /// upstream provider publishes its first descriptor list (a <see cref="FunctionsChanged"/>
    /// pulse will fire when that happens). There is no explicit per-moniker unsubscribe; the
    /// lifetime of every subscription is bound to the lifetime of this object via
    /// <see cref="IDisposable.Dispose"/>.
    /// </remarks>
    Task EnsureSubscribedAsync(ServiceMoniker moniker, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the most recently published function list for <paramref name="moniker"/>, or an
    /// empty list if no subscription exists or the provider has not yet published.
    /// </summary>
    IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> GetCachedFunctions(ServiceMoniker moniker);
}

/// <summary>
/// Default <see cref="IFirstPartyToolSubscriptions"/> backed by a per-moniker dictionary of
/// <see cref="ProviderSubscription"/>. Per-provider <c>OnNext</c> callbacks fan in to a single
/// <see cref="Subject{T}"/> so consumers see one logical change stream regardless of how many
/// providers are wired up. Each underlying subscription uses
/// <see cref="ServiceBrokerObservableExtensions"/>.<c>GetSafeObservable</c> so that
/// <see cref="IServiceBroker.AvailabilityChanged"/> automatically reconnects the proxy when an
/// upstream provider (for example an MCP server) bounces or is registered late.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// This class is not thread-safe by design. The single intended caller (
/// <see cref="FirstPartyToolsProvider.ToolsState"/>) serializes its calls through its own
/// <c>ReentrantSemaphore</c>. Any future caller must provide equivalent serialization.
/// </remarks>
internal sealed class FirstPartyToolSubscriptions : IFirstPartyToolSubscriptions
{
    private readonly IServiceBroker serviceBroker;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource disposalCts = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<ServiceMoniker, ProviderSubscription> subscriptions = new();
    private readonly Subject<Unit> functionsChanged = new();

    public FirstPartyToolSubscriptions(IServiceBroker serviceBroker)
    {
        this.serviceBroker = serviceBroker;
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public IObservable<Unit> FunctionsChanged => this.functionsChanged;

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public Task EnsureSubscribedAsync(ServiceMoniker moniker, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        if (this.subscriptions.ContainsKey(moniker))
        {
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        ProviderSubscription? subscription = null;
        try
        {
            subscription = new ProviderSubscription(moniker, this.functionsChanged);

            // Pass the disposal token (cancelled in Dispose) rather than the per-call token:
            // GetSafeObservable retains this token across every reconnect, so binding it to a
            // short-lived caller token would tear the subscription down as soon as that call
            // completed.
            subscription.Start(this.serviceBroker, this.disposalCts.Token);
            this.subscriptions[moniker] = subscription;
        }
        catch
        {
            subscription?.Dispose();
            throw;
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> GetCachedFunctions(ServiceMoniker moniker)
        => this.subscriptions.TryGetValue(moniker, out var subscription)
            ? subscription.LatestFunctions
            : Array.Empty<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>();

    public void Dispose()
    {
        // Cancel before tearing down the subscriptions so any in-flight reconnect bails out of
        // GetProxyAsync / SubscribeForFunctionsAsync rather than racing the disposal.
        this.disposalCts.Cancel();

        foreach (var subscription in this.subscriptions.Values)
        {
            subscription.Dispose();
        }

        this.subscriptions.Clear();
        this.disposalCts.Dispose();
        this.functionsChanged.OnCompleted();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Wraps a <see cref="ServiceBrokerObservableExtensions"/>.<c>GetSafeObservable</c> subscription for a
    /// single upstream provider and caches the most recently published function list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// The safe observable owns proxy acquisition, <see cref="IServiceBroker.AvailabilityChanged"/>
    /// handling, reconnect, and proxy disposal; this wrapper just adapts its <c>OnNext</c>
    /// stream into a per-moniker cache plus a pulse on the parent's fan-in <see cref="Subject{T}"/>.
    /// </remarks>
    private sealed class ProviderSubscription : IDisposable, IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>>
    {
        private readonly ServiceMoniker moniker;
        private readonly IObserver<Unit> changePump;
        private IDisposable? subscription;

        public ProviderSubscription(ServiceMoniker moniker, IObserver<Unit> changePump)
        {
            this.moniker = moniker;
            this.changePump = changePump;
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> LatestFunctions { get; private set; } = Array.Empty<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>();

        public void Start(IServiceBroker serviceBroker, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            this.subscription = serviceBroker
                .GetSafeObservable<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>, ICopilotFunctionProvider>(
                    CopilotDescriptors.CreateDescriptor(this.moniker),
                    svc => (obs, token) => svc.SubscribeForFunctionsAsync(obs, token),
                    cancellationToken)
                .Subscribe(this);
        }

        public void OnNext(IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> value)
        {
            this.LatestFunctions = value;
            this.changePump.OnNext(Unit.Default);
        }

        public void OnCompleted()
        {
        }

        public void OnError(Exception error)
        {
            // GetSafeObservable terminates the inner subscription if a reconnect attempt fails
            // (for example, the service is still unavailable when AvailabilityChanged fires).
            // We intentionally do not remove ourselves from the parent dictionary here: the
            // parent's threading invariant assumes single-threaded access serialized by an
            // external semaphore, and OnError fires on whatever thread the safe observable
            // chose. The cached LatestFunctions remains as a last-known-good snapshot until
            // the owning ToolsState is disposed. This matches the historical behavior in which
            // a faulted subscription was never retried; the new AvailabilityChanged-driven
            // reconnect path strictly improves on that for the common bounce/restart case.
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            this.subscription?.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

```
    private Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, FoundFunction>> LookupFunctionsAsync()
    {
        return Task.Run<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, FoundFunction>>(() =>
        {
            if (this.Descriptor is null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Descriptor must be set.");

            var funcs = new Dictionary<string, FoundFunction>();
            var type = this.GetType();

            // Discover regular functions from method-level [CopilotFunction] attributes first
            // (so we can validate virtual function fallbacks)
            foreach (MethodInfo method in type.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static))
            {
                if (!CopilotLocalFunctionDescriptorHelpers.TryGetFunctionAttributeFromMethodInfo(method, out CopilotFunctionAttribute? functionAttribute)
                    || functionAttribute is null)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Delegate d;
                if (method.IsStatic)
                    d = Delegate.CreateDelegate(GetDelegateType(method), type, method);
                else
                    d = Delegate.CreateDelegate(GetDelegateType(method), this, method);

                var inputs = CopilotLocalFunctionDescriptorHelpers.GetInputs(method, functionAttribute);

                CopilotTypeName? returnType = null;
                if (method.ReturnType != typeof(void))
                    returnType = CopilotTypeName.Get(method.ReturnType);

                var modelCustomizations = CopilotLocalFunctionDescriptorHelpers.GetFunctionCustomizationsFromMethodInfo(method);

                var description = new CopilotProvidedFunctionDescriptor(this.Descriptor.Moniker, functionAttribute.Name ?? method.Name, functionAttribute.Description, functionAttribute.Confirmation)
                {
                    ReturnType = returnType,
                    Arguments = inputs,
                    Group = functionAttribute.Group,
                    PerModelOptions = modelCustomizations.Select(a => a.ToModelOption()).ToList(),
                    Guidance = functionAttribute.Guidance,
                    ToolInitializingMessage = functionAttribute.ToolInitializingMessage,
                    Hidden = functionAttribute.Hidden,
                    AlwaysShowToUser = functionAttribute.AlwaysShowToUser,
```

```
    public static IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionInputDescriptor> GetInputs(MethodInfo method, CopilotFunctionAttribute functionAttribute)
    {
        List<CopilotFunctionInputDescriptor> p = new();
        // Injected parameters are not tool inputs. Exclude them before schema generation to avoid
        // recursively inspecting their object graphs and allocating schemas that would be discarded.
        JsonObject methodSchema = CopilotDefaultTypes.JsonSchemaOptions.GetJsonSchema(
            method,
            CopilotDefaultTypesInternal.JsonSchemaConfig,
            excludedParameterTypes: SpecialTypes).AsObject();
        Dictionary<string, JsonObject> methodProperties = methodSchema.ContainsKey("properties")
            ? GetValue("properties", methodSchema)
                .AsObject()
                .ToDictionary(kvp => kvp.Key, kvp => kvp.Value!.AsObject())
            : new Dictionary<string, JsonObject>();

        // Check if the "required" property exists before attempting to get its value
        HashSet<string> requiredProperties = new HashSet<string>();
        if (methodSchema.ContainsKey("required"))
        {
            var required = GetValue("required", methodSchema)
                .AsArray()
                .OfType<JsonValue>()
                .Select(jv => jv.GetValue<string>());
            requiredProperties.UnionWith(required);
        }

        bool hasBroker = false;

        foreach (ParameterInfo param in method.GetParameters())
        {
            if (SpecialTypes.Contains(param.ParameterType))
            {
                if (!hasBroker && (param.ParameterType == typeof(ICopilotFunctionBroker) || param.ParameterType == typeof(CopilotFunctionInvocationContext)))
                    hasBroker = true;

                continue;
            }

            CopilotDescriptionAttribute? pdesc = param.GetCustomAttribute<CopilotDescriptionAttribute>();
            string name = pdesc?.Name ?? param.Name;

            if (!methodProperties.TryGetValue(param.Name, out JsonObject propertySchemaObject))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Method parameters should be represented in Json schema.");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pdesc?.Description))
            {
                // If a description has been overridden then let's update the schema to reflect that for the parameter.
                propertySchemaObject["description"] = pdesc!.Description;
            }

            var schema = CopilotJsonSchema.Create(propertySchemaObject, CopilotDefaultTypes.JsonSchemaOptions);
            bool isRequired = requiredProperties.Contains(param.Name);
            p.Add(new CopilotFunctionInputDescriptor(name, param.ParameterType.AssemblyQualifiedName, schema) { IsRequired = isRequired });
        }

        if (functionAttribute.Confirmation.HasFlag(CopilotConfirmationRequirement.Required) && !hasBroker)
            throw new ArgumentException("The function requires confirmation, but ICopilotFunctionBroker is not specified as an argument.");

        return p;
    }

    private static HashSet<Type> SpecialTypes = new HashSet<Type>
```

```
    };

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ServiceRpcDescriptor Descriptor => FirstPartyToolProviderConstants.ServiceDescriptor;

    [ImportingConstructor]
    public FirstPartyToolsProvider(ToolsState globalToolState, CopilotInteractionManager interactionManager)
    {
        this.globalToolState = globalToolState;
        this.interactionManager = interactionManager;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> GetFunctionsAsync(CopilotCorrelationId correlationId, CancellationToken cancellation)
    {
        await this.globalToolState.EnsureInitializedAsync(cancellation);
        return this.globalToolState.GetActiveTools();
    }

    public async Task<IDisposable> SubscribeForFunctionsAsync(IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> observer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await this.globalToolState.EnsureInitializedAsync(cancellationToken);
        return this.globalToolState.Subscribe(observer);
    }

    public Task InitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // The public initialization is intentionally empty as we don't want to start any work before a query is made.
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IReadOnlyList<HandoffAgentDescriptor> GetHandoffAgents()
    {
        // Only offer agents whose responder is registered and whose UI context is active.
        var registeredMonikers = new HashSet<ServiceMoniker>(this.interactionManager.GetRegisteredAgents().Select(a => a.Service));

        return Candidates
            .Where(candidate =>
                registeredMonikers.Contains(candidate.Responder) &&
                UIContext.FromUIContextGuid(candidate.UIContext)?.IsActive == true)
            .ToList();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Central shared state for tracking first-party tool activations.
    /// Shared across all <see cref="FirstPartyToolsProvider"/> instances to avoid
    /// redundant UIContext subscriptions and service queries.
    /// </summary>
    [Export]
    public class ToolsState : IDisposable
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Window used to coalesce bursts of upstream provider notifications. Long enough to
        /// collapse a startup flurry of <c>OnNext</c> emissions (the initial descriptor list
        /// from each provider, plus any rapid follow-on updates and reconnect-driven replays
        /// triggered by <see cref="IServiceBroker.AvailabilityChanged"/>) into a single
        /// re-evaluation, short enough that users do not perceive a delay before tools appear.
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly TimeSpan ProviderChangeThrottleWindow = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50);

        private readonly JoinableTaskFactory jtf;
        private readonly AsyncLazyInitializer toolsInitializer;
        private readonly TraceSource traceSource;
        private readonly HostApp currentHost;
        private readonly HashSet<Guid> activeContexts = new();
        private readonly ReentrantSemaphore semaphore;
        private readonly List<UIContext> subscribedUiContexts = new();
        private readonly FirstPartyToolSubscriptions subscriptions;
        private readonly FirstPartyToolEvaluator evaluator;
        private readonly IDisposable providerChangeSubscription;

        private ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> activeTools = ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>>.Empty;
        private ImmutableList<IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>>> observers = ImmutableList<IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>>>.Empty;

        [ImportingConstructor]
        public ToolsState(
            [Import(typeof(SVsFullAccessServiceBroker))] IServiceBroker serviceBroker,
            ConversationsTraceSource conversationsTraceSource,
            [ConversationsJoinableTaskFactory] JoinableTaskFactory joinableTaskFactory,
            [Import(AllowDefault = true)] ICopilotHostEnvironment? hostEnvironment = null)
        {
            this.jtf = joinableTaskFactory;
            this.traceSource = conversationsTraceSource.TraceSource;
            this.currentHost = hostEnvironment?.Service.HostApp ?? HostApp.VisualStudio;
            this.semaphore = ReentrantSemaphore.Create(joinableTaskContext: joinableTaskFactory.Context);
            this.toolsInitializer = new AsyncLazyInitializer(this.InitializeToolsAsync, joinableTaskFactory);
            this.subscriptions = new FirstPartyToolSubscriptions(serviceBroker);
            this.evaluator = new FirstPartyToolEvaluator(FirstPartyTools, this.currentHost, this.subscriptions);

            // Coalesce upstream provider updates with Throttle so a burst of OnNext callbacks
            // (initial descriptor lists, rapid follow-on updates, and replays that fire when
            // GetSafeObservable reconnects after AvailabilityChanged) collapses into a single
            // re-evaluation. The throttle scheduler also defers emission off the calling stack,
            // which prevents reentry into ReevaluateToolsAsync from within the
            // EnsureSubscribedAsync call below.
            this.providerChangeSubscription = this.subscriptions.FunctionsChanged
                .Throttle(ProviderChangeThrottleWindow)
                .SubscribeWithoutRx(_ => this.OnProviderFunctionsChanged());
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            foreach (var context in this.subscribedUiContexts)
            {
                context.UIContextChanged -= this.OnUIContextChanged;
            }

            this.subscribedUiContexts.Clear();

            this.providerChangeSubscription.Dispose();
            this.subscriptions.Dispose();
        }

        public Task EnsureInitializedAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            => this.toolsInitializer.InitializeAsync(cancellationToken);

        public IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> GetActiveTools()
            => FilterTools(this.activeTools);

        public IDisposable Subscribe(IObserver<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> observer)
        {
            ImmutableInterlocked.Update(ref this.observers, observers => observers.Add(observer));
            observer.OnNext(this.GetActiveTools());

            return new DisposeAction(() =>
            {
                ImmutableInterlocked.Update(ref this.observers, observers => observers.Remove(observer));
            });
        }

        private async Task InitializeToolsAsync()
        {
            await this.jtf.SwitchToMainThreadAsync();

            foreach (var uiContextGuid in FirstPartyTools
                .Where(tool => tool.AppliesTo(this.currentHost))
                .Select(tool => tool.UIContext)
                .Distinct())
            {
                var uiContextImpl = UIContext.FromUIContextGuid(uiContextGuid);

                if (uiContextImpl is not null)
                {
                    if (uiContextImpl.IsActive)
                    {
                        // Safe to mutate outside the semaphore: this runs on the UI thread before the
                        // UIContextChanged handler is attached, so no other path can read activeContexts yet.
                        this.activeContexts.Add(uiContextGuid);
                    }

                    uiContextImpl.UIContextChanged += this.OnUIContextChanged;
                    this.subscribedUiContexts.Add(uiContextImpl);
                }
            }

            this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid.Empty, VsShellUtilities.ShutdownToken).FileAndForgetIgnoringCancellation(nameof(FirstPartyToolsProvider));
        }

        private void OnUIContextChanged(object sender, UIContextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            var uiContext = (UIContext)sender;
            this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(uiContext.Guid, e.Activated, VsShellUtilities.ShutdownToken).FileAndForgetIgnoringCancellation(nameof(FirstPartyToolsProvider));
        }

        private Task ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid uiContext, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            => this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(uiContext, activated: null, cancellationToken);

        private async Task ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid uiContext, bool? activated, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await this.semaphore.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
            {
                // Apply UIContext activation changes inside the semaphore so reads of activeContexts
                // during evaluation cannot race with mutations from UIContext callbacks.
                if (activated == true)
                {
                    this.activeContexts.Add(uiContext);
                }
                else if (activated == false)
                {
                    this.activeContexts.Remove(uiContext);
                }

                // Make sure we are subscribed to every upstream provider whose descriptors we may
                // need this pass. Subscriptions are idempotent and persist for the lifetime of
                // ToolsState; this loop only does real work on first call.
                foreach (var moniker in this.evaluator.GetMonikersRequiringSubscription())
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await this.subscriptions.EnsureSubscribedAsync(moniker, cancellationToken);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        this.traceSource.Error($"Failed to subscribe to {moniker} when initializing first party tools. {ex}.");
                    }
                }

                var previousTools = this.activeTools;
                var currentTools = this.evaluator.Evaluate(previousTools, this.activeContexts.Contains, uiContext);

                this.activeTools = currentTools;
                if (previousTools != currentTools)
                {
                    this.NotifyObservers(currentTools);
                }
            }, cancellationToken);
        }

        private void NotifyObservers(ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> tools)
        {
            var toolList = FilterTools(tools);
            foreach (var observer in this.observers)
            {
                try
                {
                    observer.OnNext(toolList);
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Observer faults must not break the provider; this matches the existing IObservable contract.
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Tools superseded by the handoff tool. When the handoff tool is enabled these are dropped,
        /// because the same agents are reachable through it.
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly ImmutableHashSet<string> HandoffReplacedToolNames = ImmutableHashSet.Create(
            CreateUpgradeThread.Name,
            "profiler_agent");

        private static IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> FilterTools(ImmutableDictionary<FirstPartyTool, ImmutableArray<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> tools)
        {
            var flattened = tools.Values.SelectMany(d => d);

            if (ConversationsOptions.Instance.EnableHandoffTool)
            {
                flattened = flattened.Where(tool => !HandoffReplacedToolNames.Contains(tool.Name));
            }

            return flattened.ToList();
        }

        private void OnProviderFunctionsChanged()
        {
            this.ReevaluateToolsAsync(Guid.Empty, VsShellUtilities.ShutdownToken).FileAndForgetIgnoringCancellation(nameof(FirstPartyToolsProvider));
        }
    }
```

```
/// <b>First-party allowlist</b> — the VS first-party tools available to the CLI SDK
/// (edit/create/read/remove files, build, deploy, tests, solution projects).
/// Any other VS first-party tool (<c>get_errors</c>, <c>file_search</c>, …) is dropped.
/// </item>
/// <item>
/// <b>Registry denylist</b> — extension tools that are not available to the CLI SDK.
/// </item>
/// </list>
/// MCP tools are supplied by the selected host rather than the VS function registry.
/// A tool is classified first-party by its <em>provider</em> moniker (the VS first-party function providers are
/// enumerated below). This provider list is intentionally hardcoded and therefore brittle — that is the cost of
/// maintaining an explicit CLI SDK tool policy.
/// </summary>
internal static class CliFunctionProvider
{
    // Concrete edit tools (mirror EditsFunctionHandler.ToolNames). edit_files is a virtual tool the registry may
    // surface either as the virtual name or already resolved to these concretes; both forms are allowed.
    private const string EditFile = "edit_file";
    private const string ReplaceStringInFile = "replace_string_in_file";
    private const string MultiReplaceStringInFile = "multi_replace_string_in_file";
    private const string ApplyPatch = "apply_patch";
    private static readonly ServiceMoniker EditsProvider = new("Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.EditsFunctions", new Version("0.1"));
    private static readonly ServiceMoniker ContextProvider = new("Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.ContextFunctions", new Version("0.1"));
    private static readonly ServiceMoniker TestExplorerProvider = new("Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.TestExplorerFunctions", new Version("0.1"));

    private static readonly ImmutableHashSet<FirstPartyTool> AskTools =
    [
        new(ContextProvider, KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.ReadFile),
        new(EditsProvider, KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.GetProjectsInSolution),
        new(TestExplorerProvider, KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.GetTests),
    ];

    /// <summary>
    /// The VS first-party tools the harness exposes, with <c>edit_files</c> covered in both its virtual and
    /// concrete forms, plus the SDK backend's explicitly resolved question tool.
    /// </summary>
    internal static readonly ImmutableHashSet<string> FirstPartyAllowlist = ImmutableHashSet.Create(
        StringComparer.Ordinal,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.ReadFile,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.CreateFile,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.RemoveFile,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.RunBuild,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.DeployProject,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.GetProjectsInSolution,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.GetTests,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.RunTests,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.AskQuestion,
        KnownCopilotFunctions.ToolNames.EditFiles,
        EditFile,
        ReplaceStringInFile,
        MultiReplaceStringInFile,
        ApplyPatch);

    /// <summary>
    /// Registry/extension tools the harness drops.
    /// </summary>
    internal static readonly ImmutableHashSet<string> ExcludedRegistryTools = ImmutableHashSet.Create(
        StringComparer.Ordinal,
        "start_modernization",
        "profiler_agent",
        "nuget_get-nuget-solver",
        "nuget_get-nuget-solver-latest-versions",
        "nuget_get-latest-package-version",
        "git_view_changes",
        "git_review_local_changes");

    /// <summary>
    /// Service names of the VS first-party function providers — tools from these providers are governed by the
    /// first-party allowlist; tools from other providers (extensions, recommended tools) are governed by
    /// the registry denylist. MCP descriptors are excluded before provider classification. Hardcoded to mirror
    /// each handler's <c>*FunctionServiceName</c> constant; kept here because several are <c>internal</c>.
    /// </summary>
    internal static readonly ImmutableHashSet<string> FirstPartyProviderNames = ImmutableHashSet.Create(
        StringComparer.Ordinal,
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.EditsFunctions",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.ContextFunctions",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.TestExplorerFunctions",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.OutputFunctions",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.PlanningFunctions",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.AskQuestionFunctions",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.GrepSearchFunction",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.SearchFunction",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.SubAgentFunctions",
        "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Copilot.WebPageFunction");

    /// <summary>The exposure decision for a tool, plus a short reason for diagnostics.</summary>
    /// <param name="Expose">Whether to surface the tool.</param>
    /// <param name="Reason">Why — which list drove the decision.</param>
    public readonly record struct Decision(bool Expose, string Reason);

    /// <summary>
    /// Decides whether to surface a registry-provided tool:
    /// MCP is supplied by the selected host; VS first-party tools pass only if in the first-party allowlist;
    /// other registry tools pass unless in the denylist.
    /// </summary>
    public static Decision Classify(RegisteredCopilotFunction function)
    {
        if (function.FunctionDescriptor is CopilotMcpFunctionDescriptor)
        {
            return new Decision(false, "MCP supplied by selected host");
        }

        var name = function.FunctionDescriptor.Name;

        if (FirstPartyProviderNames.Contains(function.ProviderMoniker.Name))
        {
            return FirstPartyAllowlist.Contains(name)
                ? new Decision(true, "first-party allowlisted")
                : new Decision(false, "first-party not in CLI SDK set");
        }

        return ExcludedRegistryTools.Contains(name)
            ? new Decision(false, "registry denylisted")
            : new Decision(true, "registry/extension allowed");
    }
```

```
    private readonly Dictionary<ToolSourceId, VsToolSourceContribution> bySource = new();
    private readonly Func<CopilotFunctionDescriptor, BackendToolInvoke> invokeFactory;
    private readonly Func<RegisteredCopilotFunction, CliFunctionProvider.Decision> classify;
    private readonly TraceSource trace;
    private readonly Func<CancellationToken, Task<IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction>>>? resolveBackendTools;
    private readonly object inventoryGate = new();
    private IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction> registryTools = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction> backendTools = [];
    private bool disposed;
    private ICopilotFunctionRegistry? registry;
    private CopilotSessionId sessionId;
    private IDisposable? subscription;

    public VsToolsSessionProvider(
        Func<CopilotFunctionDescriptor, BackendToolInvoke> invokeFactory,
        Func<RegisteredCopilotFunction, CliFunctionProvider.Decision> classify,
        TraceSource trace,
        Func<CancellationToken, Task<IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction>>>? resolveBackendTools = null)
    {
        this.invokeFactory = invokeFactory;
        this.classify = classify;
        this.trace = trace;
        this.resolveBackendTools = resolveBackendTools;
        this.Sources = this.sources.AsObservableCache();
    }

    /// <summary>The session's tool sources, updated live as the registry republishes.</summary>
    public IObservableCache<IBackendToolSourceContribution, ToolSourceId> Sources { get; }

    /// <summary>Starts the registry subscription for the given session.</summary>
    public async Task StartAsync(ICopilotFunctionRegistry registry, CopilotSessionId sessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        this.registry = registry;
        this.sessionId = sessionId;
        await this.RefreshBackendToolsAsync(cancellationToken);
        this.subscription = await registry.SubscribeForToolsAsync(this, sessionId, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Re-resolves backend declarations before configuration capture so gated tools can appear or disappear
    /// without depending on the recommended extension catalog or retaining a startup-only descriptor.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task RefreshBackendToolsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (this.resolveBackendTools is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        var tools = await this.resolveBackendTools(cancellationToken);
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        lock (this.inventoryGate)
        {
            if (!this.disposed)
            {
                this.backendTools = tools;
                this.PublishInventory();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public void OnNext(IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction> functions)
    {
        lock (this.inventoryGate)
        {
            if (!this.disposed)
            {
                this.registryTools = functions;
                this.PublishInventory();
            }
        }
    }

    private void PublishInventory()
    {
        // Backend declarations win collisions with extension tools in the shared VS source.
        var functions = this.registryTools.Concat(this.backendTools).ToList();
        // Classify every received tool against the harness exposure policy, logging the per-tool decision so a
        // missing/unexpected tool is diagnosable from the trace (the picker only shows the exposed set).
        var exposed = new List<RegisteredCopilotFunction>();
        var dropped = new List<string>();
        foreach (var function in functions)
        {
            var decision = this.classify(function);
            if (decision.Expose)
            {
                exposed.Add(function);
            }
            else
            {
                dropped.Add($"{function.FunctionDescriptor.Name}({decision.Reason})");
            }
        }

        this.trace.Info(
            $"[tool registry] received={functions.Count} exposed={exposed.Count} dropped={dropped.Count}" +
            $" providers=[{string.Join(",", functions.Select(f => f.ProviderMoniker.Name).Distinct())}]" +
            $" exposed=[{string.Join(",", exposed.Select(f => f.FunctionDescriptor.Name))}]" +
            (dropped.Count > 0 ? $" dropped=[{string.Join(",", dropped)}]" : string.Empty));

        var grouped = exposed
            .GroupBy(function => VsToolMapping.SourceIdOf(function.FunctionDescriptor))
            .ToList();
        var seen = new HashSet<ToolSourceId>();

        this.sources.Edit(updater =>
        {
            foreach (var group in grouped)
            {
                seen.Add(group.Key);
                var first = group.First().FunctionDescriptor;

                if (!this.bySource.TryGetValue(group.Key, out var source))
                {
                    source = new VsToolSourceContribution(
                        group.Key,
                        VsToolMapping.SourceDisplayNameOf(first),
                        VsToolMapping.KindOf(first));
                    this.bySource[group.Key] = source;
                    updater.AddOrUpdate((IBackendToolSourceContribution)source);
                }

                source.SetTools(group.Select(function =>
                    (IBackendToolContribution)new VsToolContribution(
                        function.FunctionDescriptor,
                        this.invokeFactory,
                        this.registry,
                        this.sessionId,
                        CliFunctionProvider.IsAllowedInAsk(function))));
```

```
    [ShutdownToken]

    [ImportingConstructor]
    public CopilotFunctionRegistry(
        [ConversationsJoinableTaskFactory] JoinableTaskFactory joinableTaskFactory,
        ICopilotExtensionTraceSource copilotExtensionTraceSource,
        [Import(typeof(SVsFullAccessServiceBroker))] IServiceBroker serviceBroker)
    {
        this.joinableTaskFactory = joinableTaskFactory;
        this.eventSemaphore = ReentrantSemaphore.Create(initialCount: 1, joinableTaskFactory.Context, ReentrantSemaphore.ReentrancyMode.NotRecognized);
        this.responderSemaphore = ReentrantSemaphore.Create(initialCount: 1, joinableTaskFactory.Context, ReentrantSemaphore.ReentrancyMode.NotRecognized);
        this.serviceBroker = serviceBroker;
        this.traceSource = copilotExtensionTraceSource.TraceSource.WithName(nameof(CopilotFunctionRegistry));

        this.firstPartyToolProvider = new AsyncLazy<FunctionProviderWrapper>(
            async () =>
            {
                var wrapper = new FunctionProviderWrapper(
                    serviceBroker,
                    FirstPartyToolProviderConstants.Moniker,
                    identity: null,
                    sessionId: null,
                    this.traceSource,
                    this,
                    this.joinableTaskFactory);

                wrapper.FunctionsChanged += this.OnWrapperFunctionsChanged;
                await wrapper.InitializeAsync(default);
                return wrapper;
            },

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>> GetActiveToolsAsync(
        IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction> enabledFunctions,
        CopilotRequest request,
        CopilotResponderIdentity? copilotResponder,
        CopilotSessionId copilotSessionId,
        CopilotCorrelationId correlationId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (enabledFunctions.Count == 0)
        {
            return Array.Empty<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>();
        }

        HashSet<FunctionProviderWrapper> activeWrappers = new();
        HashSet<string> enabledFunctionNames = new(enabledFunctions.Select(f => f.FunctionDescriptor.Name));

        // Get all the provider wrappers to query.
        foreach (var serviceMoniker in enabledFunctions.GroupBy(f => f.ProviderMoniker).Select(g => g.Key))
        {
            if (this.functionProviders.TryGetValue(serviceMoniker, out var wrapper))
            {
                activeWrappers.Add(wrapper);
            }
            else if (serviceMoniker == FirstPartyToolProviderConstants.Moniker)
            {
                activeWrappers.Add(await this.firstPartyToolProvider.GetValueAsync(default));
            }
        }

        IReadOnlyList<CopilotFunctionDescriptor> responderFunctions = Array.Empty<CopilotFunctionDescriptor>();
        if (copilotResponder is not null && !this.blockedResponders.Contains(copilotResponder.Service))
        {
            try
            {
                ICopilotFunctionProvider? responderProvider = await this.serviceBroker.GetProxyAsync<ICopilotFunctionProvider>(CopilotDescriptors.CreateDescriptor(copilotResponder.Service), cancellationToken);
                using (responderProvider as IDisposable)
                {
                    if (responderProvider is not null)
                    {
                        var unresolvedResponderFunctions = await responderProvider.GetFunctionsAsync(correlationId, cancellationToken);

                        // Pre-filter: Only include functions whose names are in enabledFunctionNames
                        // This filters virtual, lazy, AND regular functions by name before resolution
                        var functionsToResolve = unresolvedResponderFunctions
                            .Where(f => enabledFunctionNames.Contains(f.Name))
                            .ToList();
```

```
    private async Task<ImmutableList<RegisteredCopilotFunction>> GetSessionToolsAsync(
        CopilotSessionId sessionId,
        ImmutableList<RegisteredCopilotFunction> toolList)
    {
        if (!this.activeResponders.TryGetValue(sessionId, out var wrapper))
        {
            return toolList;
        }

        if (wrapper.DisallowExternalTools)
        {
            toolList = [];
        }

        toolList = toolList.AddRange(wrapper.Functions);

        if (!wrapper.DisallowRecommendedTools)
        {
            IEnumerable<RegisteredCopilotFunction> firstPartyTools = await this.GetFirstPartyToolsAsync(sessionId);
            toolList = toolList.RemoveAll(f => firstPartyTools.Any(fp => string.Equals(fp.DisplayName, f.DisplayName)));
            toolList = toolList.AddRange(firstPartyTools);
        }

        return toolList;
    }

    private async Task<IEnumerable<RegisteredCopilotFunction>> GetFirstPartyToolsAsync(CopilotSessionId sessionId)
    {
        if (this.activeResponders.TryGetValue(sessionId, out var wrapper))
        {
            var firstPartyToolWrapper = await this.firstPartyToolProvider.GetValueAsync(default);
            return firstPartyToolWrapper.Functions.Select(f => f with { ProviderIdentity = wrapper.ProviderIdentity });
        }

        return Array.Empty<RegisteredCopilotFunction>();
    }

    public async Task<IDisposable> SubscribeForToolsAsync(
        IObserver<IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction>> observer,
        CopilotSessionId copilotSessionId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Make sure to trigger initialization of first party tool provider on first subscription.
        await this.firstPartyToolProvider.GetValueAsync(cancellationToken);

        ImmutableInterlocked.AddOrUpdate(
            ref this.observers,
            copilotSessionId,
            (_) => ImmutableList<IObserver<IReadOnlyList<RegisteredCopilotFunction>>>.Empty.Add(observer),
            (_, existing) => existing.Add(observer));

        // Send the list one time to the observer.
        await this.NotifyObserverAsync(copilotSessionId, observer, cancellationToken);

        return new Disposable(() =>
        {
            ImmutableDictionaryRemoveOrUpdate(
                ref this.observers,
                copilotSessionId,
                (_, existing) =>
                {
                    var newValue = existing.Remove(observer);
                    return (newValue, newValue.IsEmpty);
                });
        });
    }

    public async Task UnregisterFunctionProviderAsync(
        ServiceMoniker serviceMoniker,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (ImmutableInterlocked.TryRemove(ref this.functionProviders, serviceMoniker, out FunctionProviderWrapper? removedWrapper))
        {
            removedWrapper?.Dispose();
            await this.NotifyObserversAsync(sessionId: null, cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    public async Task UpdateSessionResponderAsync(
        CopilotSessionId copilotSessionId,
        CopilotResponderIdentity? copilotResponderIdentity,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await this.responderSemaphore.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
        {
            FunctionProviderWrapper? existingWrapper = null;
            FunctionProviderWrapper? newWrapper = null;

            // If the responder is null, remove the existing one for the session if it exists.
            if (copilotResponderIdentity is null)
            {
                if (!ImmutableInterlocked.TryRemove(ref this.activeResponders, copilotSessionId, out existingWrapper))
                {
                    // Nothing to remove so just return.
                    return;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                CopilotFunctionProviderIdentity identity = new(copilotResponderIdentity.Name);
                newWrapper = new FunctionProviderWrapper(this.serviceBroker, copilotResponderIdentity.Service, identity, copilotSessionId, this.traceSource, parentRegistry: this, this.joinableTaskFactory)
                {
                    DisallowExternalTools = copilotResponderIdentity?.DisallowExternalTools ?? false,
                    DisallowRecommendedTools = copilotResponderIdentity?.DisallowRecommendedTools ?? false,
                };
                existingWrapper = ReplaceExisting(newWrapper);
            }

            existingWrapper?.Dispose();

            if (newWrapper is not null)
            {
                newWrapper.FunctionsChanged += this.OnWrapperFunctionsChanged;
                await newWrapper.InitializeAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
            else if (existingWrapper is not null)
            {
                // If a new responder is not added, make sure we notify the observers. Otherwise newWrapper.InitializeAsync will do it.
                _ = this.NotifyObserversAsync(existingWrapper.SessionId, cancellationToken);
            }
        }, cancellationToken);

        FunctionProviderWrapper? ReplaceExisting(FunctionProviderWrapper newWrapper)
        {
            // If new wrapper was added successfully, set existing wrapper to null since there was no old one.
            FunctionProviderWrapper existing = ImmutableInterlocked.GetOrAdd(ref this.activeResponders, copilotSessionId, newWrapper);
            if (existing == newWrapper)
            {
                return null;
            }

            // TryUpdate should always succeed here since this method is called from single (main) thread.
            Assumes.True(ImmutableInterlocked.TryUpdate(ref this.activeResponders, copilotSessionId, newWrapper, existing));
            return existing;
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        var providersToDispose = this.functionProviders;
        this.functionProviders = ImmutableDictionary<ServiceMoniker, FunctionProviderWrapper>.Empty;

        foreach (var wrapper in providersToDispose.Values)
        {
            wrapper.Dispose();
        }

        this.namedFunctionLookup = ImmutableDictionary<string, ServiceMoniker>.Empty;
        this.virtualFunctionResolutionCache.Clear();
    }
```
